lines.4: The Princess seems to be in good spirits.
lines.9: 「Inori is at home, insisting that she is still on summer vacation.」
lines.10: 「Therefore, I have flown here as her substitute.」
lines.12: 「Now, now, settle down, chicks. I despise those who make a racket, chirping like birds.」
lines.13: 「I shall impart some valuable wisdom. If you see a street picture-card show starting, line up at once. They might hand out starch-syrup candy.」
lines.14: 「I've never even seen a street picture-card show.」
